data.name: Ghaffara
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root ‘ghafara’ which means ‘to cover or conceal’. In the Islamic context, it refers to the one who covers or forgives sins. It is also mentioned in the Quran as a name for one of the virtuous female companions of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes forgiveness, mercy, and compassion in Islam.
